mapper.sql: p.id, p.code, p.title, p.version, p.category, p.summary, p.required, p.status, p.effective_at, p.publisher_id, p.created_at, p.updated_at, pub.real_name AS publisher_name, (SELECT count(*) FROM policy_acceptance a WHERE a.policy_id = p.id) AS accept_count, pa.version AS accepted_version, pa.accepted_at, (pa.id IS NOT NULL) AS accepted
FROM policy p LEFT JOIN sys_user pub ON pub.id = p.publisher_id LEFT JOIN policy_acceptance pa ON pa.policy_id = p.id AND pa.user_id = #{userId} AND pa.version = p.version
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO policy (code, title, version, category, summary, content, required, status, effective_at, publisher_id) VALUES (#{code}, #{title}, #{version}, #{category}, #{summary}, #{content}, #{required}, #{status}, COALESCE(#{effectiveAt}, now()), #{publisherId})
mapper.update: UPDATE policy SET title = #{title}, version = #{version}, category = #{category}, summary = #{summary}, content = #{content}, required = #{required}, status = #{status}, effective_at = COALESCE(#{effectiveAt}, effective_at), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE policy SET status = #{status}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT
AND p.status = 1 AND p.category = #{category}
AND (p.title ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR p.code ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR p.summary ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY p.required DESC, p.effective_at DESC, p.id

SELECT , p.content
WHERE p.status = 1 AND p.required = 1 AND pa.id IS NULL ORDER BY p.id

SELECT p.id, p.code, p.title, p.version, p.category, p.summary, p.required, p.status, p.effective_at, p.publisher_id, p.created_at, p.updated_at, pub.real_name AS publisher_name, (SELECT count(*) FROM policy_acceptance a WHERE a.policy_id = p.id) AS accept_count, false AS accepted FROM policy p LEFT JOIN sys_user pub ON pub.id = p.publisher_id
ORDER BY ${sortCol} ${sortDir}, p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO policy_acceptance (user_id, policy_id, version, ip) VALUES (#{userId}, #{policyId}, #{version}, #{ip}) ON CONFLICT (user_id, policy_id, version) DO NOTHING
mapper.select:
SELECT a.id AS "id", a.user_id AS "userId", u.username AS "username", u.real_name AS "realName", a.policy_id AS "policyId", p.title AS "policyTitle", p.code AS "policyCode", a.version AS "version", a.ip AS "ip", a.accepted_at AS "acceptedAt" FROM policy_acceptance a JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.user_id JOIN policy p ON p.id = a.policy_id
ORDER BY ${sortCol} ${sortDir}, a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FROM policy_acceptance a JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = a.user_id

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM policy) AS "policies", (SELECT count(*) FROM policy WHERE status = 1) AS "published", (SELECT count(*) FROM policy WHERE required = 1 AND status = 1) AS "required", (SELECT count(*) FROM policy_acceptance) AS "acceptances", (SELECT count(*) FROM policy_acceptance WHERE accepted_at >= date_trunc('day', now())) AS "today", (SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) FROM policy_acceptance) AS "signers"
